events.label: Наука
entries: 1960 – In Huntsville, Alabama, US President Dwight D. Eisenhower formally dedicates the Marshall Space Flight Center (NASA had already activated the facility on July 1).
2000 – NASA launches Space Shuttle Atlantis on STS-106 to resupply the International Space Station.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1781 – American Revolutionary War: The Battle of Eutaw Springs in South Carolina, the war's last significant battle in the Southern theater, ends in a narrow British tactical victory.
1971 – In Washington, D.C., the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts is inaugurated, with the opening feature being the premiere of Leonard Bernstein's Mass.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1565 – St. Augustine, Florida is founded by Spanish admiral and Florida's first governor, Pedro Menéndez de Avilés.
1954 – The Southeast Asia Treaty Organization (SEATO) is established.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1966 – The landmark American science fiction television series Star Trek premieres with its first-aired episode, "The Man Trap".

1975 – Gays in the military: US Air Force Tech Sergeant Leonard Matlovich, a decorated veteran of the Vietnam War, appears in his Air Force uniform on the cover of Time magazine with the headline "I Am A Homosexual". He is given a general discharge, later upgraded to honorable.
